title: exudyn.symbolic: stage 4 of the table - the old flat evaluation, its derivative and the tree derivative removed
author: Claude-JG
description: Revision2026c step RG12.65.5 of #3153. FlatProgram keeps the order of the operations only; every recording is evaluated and differentiated by SymbolicProgram, esym.SetTableEvaluation (introduced by #3157, not released) removed; FlatProgram::Evaluate and Differentiate removed; the tree derivative (Diff and DiffRef of the node classes, DiffSeed) removed, Diff of Python by the one-pass derivative of the table; the rules: Zero for leaves, RealAbs, NoDerivative for mod, min, max, raising only where the variable enters.
releaseNotes: exudyn.symbolic: every recording is evaluated and differentiated by the table of operations; esym.SetTableEvaluation, the flat evaluation of the nodes and the tree derivative removed; Diff of Real, Vector and Matrix by the one-pass derivative of the table: piecewise constant functions have the derivative zero as in EvaluateJacobian, mod, min and max raise only where the variable enters them
